The FID is a 3 × 3 matrices test... In the VEK test, participants have to remember a bus route... In the WB test, participants have to decide which of four alternatives closest matches the meaning of a target word. IQ Aspect.evidence_source: General intelligence (g) was assessed by means of four subtests of the Intelligence Structure Battery... The INSBAT is theoretically grounded on the Cattell–Horn–Carroll model of intelligence... involving a g-factor as well as five secondary factors, including fluid (gf) and crystallized (gc) intelligence... The estimate of g used in this study is based on the factor loadings of the INSBAT subtests, which means that g is most strongly predicted by gf.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the assessment of general intelligence (g) for a study using the Intelligence Structure Battery (INSBAT). The INSBAT comprises four computer-based subtests: figural-inductive reasoning (FID), verbal short-term memory (VEK), arithmetic flexibility (NF), and word meaning (WB). The assessment is grounded in the Cattell–Horn–Carroll model, measuring g, fluid intelligence (Gf), and crystallized intelligence (Gc), with the estimate of g being most strongly predicted by Gf.
